name: unsafe fn assume_init (self) -> Arc < [T] , A >
rule: Before calling `assume_init`, the caller must ensure that every element of the inner slice is fully initialized as a valid value of type `T`; calling it when any element is not fully initialized causes immediate undefined behavior.
api: impl < T , A : Allocator > alloc::sync::Arc < [mem::MaybeUninit < T >] , A > { unsafe fn assume_init (self) -> alloc::sync::Arc < [T] , A > }
